original.target_description: Study 3, culture (American versus Indian) by condition (choice construal versus hand-touch control) interaction in number of button presses while viewing the same six-minute video; 2 x 2 ANOVA.

n.location: p. 394 (article page 4), Study 3 Method/Participants and Results
n.quote:
Participants were 60 students (37 women, 22
men, 1 person with unreported gender) at Stanford University
and 68 students (24 women, 41 men, 3 people with unreported
gender) at the M.S. Ramaiah Institute of Technology, India.
n.sample_role: Student participants; analytic sample for the interaction not explicitly established.
n.exclusions: Not documented in Study 3. Recruitment counts are 60 and 68, whereas the ANOVA reports denominator df = 120; no analytic n inferred from df.

replication.target_description: Final report focal H* test: culture by task interaction in response-button count, 2 x 2 ANOVA; final analytic sample of 448 online participants.

n.quote: The final analytic sample for this replication included 448 observations
n.sample_role: Participant observations in the final analytic sample.
n.exclusions: Report pp. 4–5: incomplete task, not watching video, not clicking button, inability to answer video questions; all 448 observations satisfying inclusion criteria retained. Video-skipping exclusion was not applied because skipping was disabled.

reported_success.quote:
The results are remarkably similar to
the original paper, not only yielding the same overall effect, but also nearly identical means for
each cell.

notes: Original title and DOI verified in primary full text from author website. OSF ab762 is the final report file under project afznv; report dated December 01, 2020, despite the supplied reference date in 2025. Original page 4 contains several tests; replication report p. 2 explicitly selects Study 3 culture-by-condition interaction, which identifies the matching original test. Original interaction prints F but no Cohen f-squared or other named effect size; es.value left null and printed F retained in test_statistic. No conversion performed. Original recruited counts do not establish analytic n. Replication narrative p-value retained at its printed precision; ANOVA table separately rounds this to 0.00001. Replication report explicitly describes an online sampling deviation from original college-student on-site testing.
